title: Psychedelic Mushroom Queen
description: A surreal psychedelic painting features a green-skinned woman with one eye closed and the other a swirling orange spiral dripping red. She wears a crown and holds a glowing orb with a spiral pattern. Below her is a large red-and-yellow mushroom with white dots, surrounded by vibrant pink, purple, and blue cosmos flowers dripping red liquid. A cobra snake appears on the left against a cosmic galaxy background with stars and nebulae.
